test_scenario: Verify that a student, after being granted permission to speak, can cancel their intervention.
pre_condition: Student is logged in, enrolled in the course, has joined an active video session, and has been granted permission to speak by the Teacher.
expected_result: The student's audio/video broadcast stops, the main video view reverts to the teacher/previous presenter, and the 'Cancel Intervention' button is no longer active.
post_condition: Student intervention is cancelled and broadcast is stopped.

test_steps.step: Student clicks the 'Ask for Intervention' button.
Teacher grants intervention permission to the student.
Student verifies their audio/video is broadcasting.
Student verifies their audio/video broadcast stops.
Teacher verifies the student's broadcast has ceased.

uncovered_conditions: Student-Specific Actions: 3 (Student can click the 'Cancel Intervention' button to stop broadcasting)
